traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Zosteraceae: leaves alternate; leaves simple; margins entire; veins parallel; blades linear; leaf rosettes basal or none; plants usually monoecious, rarely dioecious; ovary superior; stems herbaceous; flowers in spikes; perianth absent; fruit achene; stamens 1; carpels 1. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
